subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When rung 0 runs, the harness shall execute the repo's format and lint verbs and its own neutral checks — secret scan and forbidden-artifact hygiene (committed binaries, baked absolute paths) — none of which require any repo-supplied capability beyond the manifest's verb bindings.
rationale: the instant rung: broadest catches at lowest latency, available on every repo
fit_criterion: fixture diffs containing a seeded secret and a committed binary each produce a red rung-0 verdict with the class-named finding; rung-0 wall-time on the dogfood repo meets NFR-1
